notes.title: Release Patch 5
notes.notes:
Quality of life changes and improvements to the custom level editor and its menus.


 Install Folder Access: Can now open the custom level install folder from within the game.
 Blank Custom Level Generation: Can now generate a new blank custom level within the game.
 Streamlined Menu Access: The exit button on the custom level in game pause screen now sends you to the custom level editor selection screen rather than the main menu.

notes.title: The Original Level Update - Now Available!
notes.notes:
By popular demand, I am happy to announce the addition of the Original Beta Level of Try Not To Plummet as an additional free content update! Alongside this major content addition, this update comes with 4 new achievements added in relation to the Original Beta Level!

Original Beta Level
In earlier builds of Try Not To Plummet the Original Beta Level was intended to be the main stage of game, though was scrapped in favour of the reworked main level that came with the initial release version of Try Not To Plummet. There were a number of factors that went into deciding this rework, though the major reason was the short length of the Original Beta Level, being half the length of the base game. 

Whilst the overall gameplay experience of the Original Beta Level is quite similar to the base game, I would describe the Beta Level as vastly easier in comparison to the unforgiving nature of the base game's level design. The Original Beta Level having less blind jumps, no lasers, and no hook jumps - if you enjoy the mechanics of the base game but would rather not deal with as much stress while climbing, I would recommend giving the Original Beta Level an attempt. As it is vastly more forgiving, the Beta Level is perfect for both new players and veterans to hone and practice their skills whilst also providing a good challenge for everyone!

The Original Beta Level can be accessed via the Extras Menu, which is available off the Main Menu of the game.

Achievements
With this content update, there comes 4 new achievements relating to the Original Beta Level, with each pertaining to the 4 different modifier combinations available in the game's Extras menu. These 4 achievements include the following:

 Beat the Beta Level
 Beat the Beta Level with Original Physics Enabled
 Beat the Beta Level with Hard Mode Enabled (perma death)
 Beat the Beta Level with All Custom Modifiers Enabled


All major content added in this update can be found within the Extras Menu, which is available off the Main Menu of the game.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please contact me at uncreditedgame@gmail.com and I will respond as soon as possible.

Happy Climbing!

Uncredited

notes.notes:
A small bug fix.


Bug Fix:  Music playing in credits will now stop when returning to main menu.

notes.title: Release Patch 3
notes.notes:
Small adjustments to the level map, level texture fixes, and bugfixes.


Level Adjustments: Moved blocks around to improve player visibility (at approximately ~50% A.H.).
Texture Fix:  Fixed incorrectly textured laser block (at approximately ~90% B.H.).
Bug Fixes:  Fixed bug where the credits scrolling would not speed up correctly when fast forward button held.

notes.title: Release Patch 1
notes.notes:
Within this release patch comes a few small bugfixes, a slight adjustment to the level, and some quality of life changes!


Quality of Life Changes:  The cutscene at the beginning of the game is now skippable (via pressing either START on controller or ESCAPE on keyboard), and players can now see movement/fuel values by pressing F3 in game.
Level Adjustments:  Adjusted the fall trajectory of part of the level to not send you to Rat's pit via introduction of a new catch point (at approximately ~65% B.H.).
Bug Fix: Textured an untextured block.
